scripts.dev: concurrently --names web,api --prefix-colors blue,green "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:api"
scripts.build:apps: npm run build --workspace=@workflow/api && npm run build --workspace=@workflow/web
scripts.build: npm run build:contracts && npm run build:apps
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace=@workflow/contracts && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.lint: npm run build --workspace=@workflow/contracts && npm run lint --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace=@workflow/contracts && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.harness:check: npm run codegraph:check && npm run deployment:check
scripts.verify: npm run harness:check && npm run db:validate && npm run db:generate && npm run build:contracts && npm run test:workspaces && npm run lint:workspaces && npm run typecheck:workspaces && npm run build:apps && npm run test:e2e
